name: [UPDATED!] Jail Tycoon 👮
desc:
Welcome to Jail Tycoon!

Build your own jail, fill it with prisoners, and operate with police officers, guards, and more!
🚨Customize your jail however you want!
💰Collect ore for money to buy upgrades!
🚓Populate your jail however you want with a dozen characters to chose from!
✅Your progress will be saved automatically

A game by Shark Fin Studios, LLC.
